Out of scope: retrospective educational/research evaluation only.

reviewer_findings.risk: Automated checks may be mistaken for human answer review.
reviewer_findings.defensive_improvement: Split completion into internal diagnostic, human review, expert certification, and operational scopes.

reviewer_findings.risk: The selected 60-case LLM sample can be overread as the full S7 benchmark.
reviewer_findings.defensive_improvement: Report 317 retrieval labels separately from the selected 60-case LLM diagnostic, with per-mode sample counts.
reviewer_findings.claim_boundary: LLM metrics are selected-sample diagnostics, not full-label coverage.

reviewer_findings.risk: Schema/profile conformance can be conflated with semantic correctness.
reviewer_findings.defensive_improvement: Keep structural acceptance, semantic precision/recall/F1, and evidence support as separate columns.
reviewer_findings.claim_boundary: Profile validity is not equivalent to domain truth.

reviewer_findings.risk: Citation precision alone hides incomplete evidence coverage.
reviewer_findings.defensive_improvement: Report citation recall and describe future span-level adequacy checks.
reviewer_findings.claim_boundary: Citation validity does not prove full source-span support.

reviewer_findings.risk: GraphRAG gains may depend on route, top-k, or token budget choices.
reviewer_findings.defensive_improvement: Separate primary token-matched comparisons from diagnostic dense/vector sensitivity modes.
reviewer_findings.claim_boundary: Results support source-bounded routed GraphRAG diagnostics.

reviewer_findings.risk: LLM provider, prompt, and selected-case provenance can be underspecified.
reviewer_findings.defensive_improvement: Surface model, sample counts, prompt boundary, and required regeneration artifacts in the report.
reviewer_findings.claim_boundary: Reproducibility is artifact-level unless raw provider traces are added.

safe_thesis_claim: This thesis presents a retrospective, source-bounded ATCSCC case study showing that a NASA ATMONTO-derived application profile can constrain KG extraction, preserve inspectable provenance, and support layered GraphRAG retrieval and answer diagnostics. The strongest claims are structural/profile conformance, evidence traceability, benchmark-specific retrieval and answer diagnostics, and abstention behavior. Automated consistency diagnostics are an internal error-discovery layer, not human review, expert certification, domain-general proof, or operational aviation validation.
